mission: Prove or leave explicitly unresolved every evidence requirement in the frozen goal using reproducible rendered facts; use Dembrandt only to discover and prioritize candidates.
tasks: turn each mustPreserve, reference page and required state into a falsifiable evidence question before extraction
run Dembrandt or another approved extractor as an internal candidate-discovery todo
capture full-page and key-region screenshots before interpreting source code
create a section-fidelity manifest for every high-salience or goal-critical section
for long, multi-module, carousel, video, sticky or motion-bearing pages capture continuous playback plus lossless frames and a machine-readable timeline
identify visible patterns and visual weight from captures
locate the corresponding visible DOM and real interaction state
record computed property names and values
trace source rules only after the rendered fact is established
inventory loaded assets and their use
cache source URL, viewport, capture hash, asset hash and interaction traces
disposition goal-relevant and high-salience third-party seeds as validated, rejected, unresolved or out-of-scope
separate observed, inferred, not-observed and unavailable evidence
requirements: every observed high-salience claim has a screenshot path and normalized sourceRegion
every page required by goal evidencePolicy has fullPageCapture, continuousCapture and timeline or an explicit unavailableReason
continuous capture covers stable initial state through reachable page end and can be traced back to lossless frames with time and scroll/state labels
motion and interaction evidence contains default, transition and settled states
every interaction claim has before/after state captures and a reproducible trigger
every computed claim records the exact property name and value
state semantics preserve the observed state name: is-open cannot be rewritten as active/current
every mustPreserve item has a traceable evidence reference or an unresolved/unavailable verdict
every core page has a source screenshot
CSS-only and third-party output remain candidate or seed evidence
when third-party seed evidence exists brand-evidence.json contains non-empty thirdPartySeedDispositions
validated seed dispositions reference observed claims
unresolved seed dispositions block any dependent mustPreserve item
mustNot: treat Dembrandt as a separate role or handoff authority
treat filenames or brand reputation as rendered facts
treat code existence as user-visible evidence
promote third-party seeds directly to observed claims
rename CSS properties or interaction states into stronger semantics
passCriteria: all required reference pages are covered or explicitly unavailable
source observation page and interaction coverage meet the frozen goal
all required evidence paths and hashes exist
failCriteria: required page lacks full-page or continuous evidence
continuous capture cannot be traced to frames/timeline
long-page capture does not reach the page end
critical claim lacks an evidence id
observed claim lacks visible capture/region/DOM state
computed property differs from the source rule
validated seed lacks an observed claim reference
a mustPreserve item depends on an unresolved seed
receiptRequirements: agentExecutionId from a real spawned subagent
input and output file sha256 values
on fail, failureOwnerRole identifies brandResearcher, designTranslator, designDirectorOrchestrator, or demoImplementationAgent
